provenance.description: Ada Township Election Day polling places and absentee drop boxes, by precinct, with the clerk's office -- which is where an absentee ballot goes when no drop box is listed.
provenance.source: Kent County Clerk / Register of Deeds, Drop Box & Polling Locations
provenance.archive_note: An existing capture, 306 days old, cited rather than made. It may show an earlier version of the page than the one read here.
provenance.licence: Public record of Kent County, redistributed as published.
provenance.how_to_update: Run refresh_polling.py. Polling places change every election, and MCL 168.662 settles them 60 days out, so re-run after that date for each election.
provenance.not_geocoded: The browser geocodes these against the street chunk it already loaded, so no coordinate here can go stale.

clerk.address: 7330 Thornapple River Dr SE, P.O. Box 370, Ada, MI 49301
